dedupe_keys.name: city of cape town urban datasets for accessibility analysis map project

description: This dataset contains six datasets for the metropolitan area of Cape Town, South Africa, prepared for the MAP (Mapping Accessibility for Ethically Informed Urban Planning) project: land use points for all places of employment, MyCiTi bus rapid transit stops as a CSV of vertices with coordinates and MyCiTi route edges as a shapefile with source and target stops and travel time in minutes, Metrorail stations and rail route edges in the same form, and neighbourhood geometries with linked socio-economic data. A data dictionary spreadsheet describes each dataset's structure. Coverage is the City of Cape Town. Access: free shapefile and CSV downloads from 4TU.ResearchData under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, published in December 2024. Caveats: the licence bars commercial use, travel times are fixed per edge, not timetabled, and the network covers only MyCiTi and Metrorail. It supports public transport accessibility and equity analysis, network topology studies of bus rapid transit and rail, and disruption scenarios for Cape Town, and complements the UrbanAccess tool catalogued here.
name: City of Cape Town urban datasets for accessibility analysis (MAP project)
provider: 4TU.ResearchData (Nelson), MAP Mapping Accessibility for Ethically Informed Urban Planning project
